meta.sigma: ATM IV / sqrt(252) x spot (the options own one-day move, known at the capture)
meta.placebo: real level +-0.25 and +-0.5 sigma, dropped within 0.1 sigma of any real level
meta.lockbox: sessions after 2026-08-21 are included: the lockbox protocol bars scoring forecast layers 3/5/6 only, so these sessions are now SEEN for OI-level questions

offsetSweep.note: shift<0 puts the test line that many sigma on the near (arrival) side of the drawn level, so price meets it sooner; shift>0 puts it past the drawn level, so price must travel further
